purpose: City-specific official property-registration/cadastre and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry review.
assessment: The City’s official Assessor and Registry of Deeds confirm local real-property assessment, tax mapping, GIS and title registration. The city website links ULIS, but its landing page currently shows scheduled maintenance; no anonymous parcel geometry was retrieved.
registryAssessment: The City Assessment Department documents citywide tax mapping and a GIS, plus property-location map and sketch/subdivision-plan services. The Registry of Deeds is listed as the local title-registration office. These are positive local office signals, not evidence of an open feature service.

searchQueries.query: Cagayan de Oro official City Assessor GIS tax mapping parcel map Registry of Deeds
searchQueries.scope: Locate city-local cadastral/property-registration services and check for anonymous public parcel geometry.
searchQueries.result: The official City Assessment Department documents citywide tax mapping/GIS, tax declarations, and property-location maps; the City Registry of Deeds documents local registration of land titles. The city links a Unified Land Information System, but that portal currently shows scheduled-maintenance content. No anonymous feature-query endpoint or parcel geometry at the WUP point was verified.
searchQueries.executionMethod: Separate English-language search followed by review of official city and Land Registration Authority sources; checked the city-linked ULIS landing page.

officialPrimarySources.observation: City Assessment Department mandate includes real-property tax mapping, GIS and records; it lists tax declarations and location/vicinity maps as frontline services.
City page lists a Registry of Deeds at Archbishop Hayes Street, with land-title/deed registration and certified-title services.
City GIS Maps portal identifies ULIS as a Land Information System and links to ulis.cagayandeoro.gov.ph.
City-linked ULIS landing page returned a scheduled-maintenance message; no parcel layer/schema or anonymous feature endpoint was accessible.
City charter describes property-location verification and tax-map services at the City Assessor; map/document access follows a client request workflow.
National LRA explains certified title copies are requested through Registries of Deeds; title services concern registered documents rather than public parcel-vector geometry.

viewerAndServiceTrace.notes: The city’s official online-services page labels ULIS as its Land Information System and links directly to it. The linked site currently reports maintenance. No public parcel layer, schema or anonymous point-query route was identified; no authenticated services were accessed.

geometryEvidence.requestFilter: No parcel query; ULIS landing page reports maintenance.
geometryEvidence.limitations: No public parcel-feature response was obtained.

privacy: No owner, title, tax-declaration or address attributes were queried or retained. No credentials, tokens or personal information were submitted.
